component: EWS C++ fallible pointer flow grouping

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D232254 review asks for whitespace between distinct XPCOM assignments and before comments. Its only blocking request is braces; the whitespace and explicit smart-pointer out-parameter variable are readability suggestions. Actual GetTrashFolder separates root lookup, Trash lookup, null-output reason/check and forget(result) transfer. Fixed HandleDeleteOperation similarly separates fallible Trash retrieval from null and interface checks. Use meaningful groups in this scoped C++ flow, without a fixed blank-line count or adding a gap after every statement. Alphabetical sorting is a separate preference; the final historical cpp is not fully alphabetical.
title: Group fallible XPCOM pointer steps and their reason comments
